content.text:
**Repaired finding submitted: deviation on §§ 21.1 and 21.3 (LOL-CAP), preferred level.**

Two surgical replaces:

1. **§ 21.1** — "Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000." This lifts the one-month basis to the preferred greater-of formula and removes "without exception", so the § 21.3 Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) become genuine super-cap items.
2. **§ 21.3 final sentence** — payment carve-out broadened from "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" to "amounts due under this Agreement", curing the verifier's gap (defined "Fees" excludes taxes, expenses, interest and the implementation charge) without adding illustrative lists.

Mutuality of the cap (§ 21.1) and the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion (§ 21.2) remain already met and untouched; the Customer-favourable direct-damages language and the Excluded Claims definition are preserved verbatim.
